name: Nimble
description: Manage Nimble CRM (contacts, activities, deals, tasks, notes) from any AI agent. 9 tools, OAuth2 auth.
instructions:
This connector wraps the Nimble REST API v1 (app.nimble.com/api/v1). You authorize it once, in AnythingMCP; access tokens are then renewed automatically.

**Setup**:
1. Sign in to https://app.nimble.com → **Settings → Integrations → API → Create OAuth app**, with the redirect URI `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` on AnythingMCP Cloud, or `<your AnythingMCP server URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` when you host AnythingMCP yourself. Nimble only redirects to the URI registered on the app.
2. Enter the app's `client_id` as `NIMBLE_CLIENT_ID` and its `client_secret` as `NIMBLE_CLIENT_SECRET`, leave `NIMBLE_REFRESH_TOKEN` empty, and install.
3. Open the connector and click **Authorize with Provider**. Sign in to Nimble, allow access, and you land back on the connector page with the tools ready.

**Scopes**: `basic,contacts,deals` (comma-separated, as Nimble expects), which covers every tool here.

**Already have a refresh token?** You can paste it into `NIMBLE_REFRESH_TOKEN` instead of step 3, if you obtained it yourself for the same app (authorization code from `https://app.nimble.com/oauth/authorize`, exchanged at `https://app.nimble.com/oauth/token`).

**Authentication**: OAuth2 — engine handles the refresh. Access token sent as `Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN`.

**Contact model**: Nimble unifies leads + contacts + companies into a single 'Contact' object with `record_type` discriminator (`person` or `company`). Fields are namespaced — `fields['email'][0].value`, `fields['first name'][0].value` etc.

**Pagination**: `page` (1-based) + `per_page` (max 30).

**Rate limits**: 5 req/sec per token. 429 → exponential backoff.

**Out of scope here**: pipeline analytics, social-listening streams, email-sync settings, group messaging.

NIMBLE_REFRESH_TOKEN.label: Refresh token
NIMBLE_REFRESH_TOKEN.help: Leave empty: Authorize with Provider fills it in. Paste one only if you already obtained a refresh token for the same app yourself.

tools.name: nimble_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people + companies). Filter by record_type, query, tag.

sort.description: Field name. Prefix with - for desc.

tools.name: nimble_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by ID with all fields, tags, social-network links.

tools.name: nimble_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact. `fields` is the Nimble namespaced shape — `{"first name":[{value:'John'}], email:[{value:'a@b.com', modifier:'work'}]}`.

tools.name: nimble_update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact (PATCH semantics — supply only fields you want changed).

tools.name: nimble_list_activities
tools.description: List activities (calls, meetings, tasks, emails) for the workspace.

tools.name: nimble_create_activity
tools.description: Create an activity (task, call note, meeting log).
